$comment: Scored ground truth for fixtures/corpus/session-04-misreflection.txt (phone follow-up with a 71-year-old widower; the worker repeatedly reflects facts back wrongly and the client corrects her) against the mock EHR (fixtures/mock-ehr/FIELDS.md keys and option values).

Every one of the 107 FIELDS.md keys appears in exactly one scoring bucket: must_fill, acceptable, checkbox_constraints, text_match, narrative, derived (non-null entries), clinician_only, must_leave_blank, or not_scored. The field with no id/name is keyed by its profiler hash, 'f_f79934c38a'.

Exception, by design: a null derived entry (instrument not done or incomplete) is an assertion that the page-computed value must stay empty; that key is ALSO in must_leave_blank, which is the bucket that owns it.
must_fill: exact value. Strings for text/select/radio/date (radio values are '0'..'3'); a sorted array of option values for checkbox groups.
acceptable: any listed value passes; null means left blank / insufficient_evidence.
checkbox_constraints: the filled array must contain every must_include value and none of the must_exclude values; other options are unscored. An empty must_include means blank also passes.

text_match: normalize 'digits' strips everything except 0-9; 'case_insensitive' case-folds, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace; 'date' parses to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. match 'equals' (default) compares the normalized strings; match 'contains' requires every string in value (string or array) to be a substring of the normalized fill.

narrative: scored by concept, not wording (keyword or LLM judge). Every must_mention concept should appear; any must_not_mention concept is a violation. Every sentence must also carry a verified citation (DESIGN §7).
derived: computed in code from the filled items and asserted after fill. Never extracted by the model.
clinician_only: never sent to the model; must surface as 'needs your judgement' and stay blank.
must_leave_blank: any non-empty value is a hard gate violation (BUILD_PLAN P1.6). For checkbox groups, blank means an empty array.
risk_fields: zero errors allowed (hard gate). Each is scored under whichever bucket owns it above.
not_scored: session metadata the app supplies (not extracted from the transcript).

Trap class: worker misreflection. The worker's wrong paraphrase is a WORKER segment and the correction is the CLIENT's. The client's version wins every time. A value supported only by the worker's wrong reflection (or by a bare 'No' read as agreement) is fabrication.
GAD-7 is complete (derived 9, MILD); the PHQ-9 is not given this session, so its items are blank and its derived values null.
ADLs and IADLs ARE assessed in this session, so they are must_fill, unlike the rest of the corpus.

must_mention: ongoing grief: wife Joan died two years ago this November
evenings and supper time are hardest; eats in front of the TV
sleeps about 5 hours though in bed 8; wakes at 2-3 a.m.
mood lonesome and tired
passive death wishes on a couple of nights
must_not_mention: Joan died about a year ago
active suicidal thoughts or thoughts of ending his life

must_mention: owns his home (paid off in 2009)
adult daughter Carol moved in with him in August after her divorce; her sons are grown and live elsewhere
retired from the post office in 2017; income is Social Security and a postal pension
married 46 years
friend Walt (40 years, calls every Sunday) and nephew Pete
no longer drives; Carol and the senior van provide transportation
must_not_mention: client moved in with / is staying at his daughter's
attends a grief group or church

must_mention: GAD-7 administered
ADL/IADL functional check
suicide risk check-in: passive ideation explored; plan, intent and prior attempts asked; homicidal ideation asked
existing safety plan reviewed with the client, no changes
988 reiterated
supportive listening around grief; goal-setting
client will try eating at the table once or twice this week
keep the safety plan by the kitchen phone
biweekly phone sessions; next appointment Tuesday 2026-10-20 at 11:00
insists on accuracy; engaged and forthright
independent with self-care, bills and medications
long friendship with Walt; daughter and nephew nearby
cares for his dog Biscuit, which gets him walking
never misses appointments
passive ideation: some nights thinks it would be all right not to wake up, to be with his late wife
explicitly corrected the worker: not thinking of ending his life, not going to do anything
a couple of nights in the past two weeks
no plan; no intent (would not do that to Carol)
no prior attempts
denies homicidal ideation
existing safety plan reviewed; 988 reiterated
must_not_mention: an overall risk level (low / moderate / high / imminent)

traps.description: Worker: 'So you're staying with your daughter now?' Client: 'No — she stays with me. She moved into my place after her divorce.' 'It's my house. I paid it off in '09.'
traps.rule: housing_status = STABLE (not DOUBLED_UP); living_situation = WITH_FAMILY. No narrative says he lives at his daughter's.

traps.description: Worker: 'you'd been drinking more since Joan passed?' Client: 'No, I said less.' One beer two weeks ago; 'Once a month, maybe.'
traps.rule: alcohol_frequency = MONTHLY_OR_LESS; substances includes ALCOHOL (one beer within 30 days). No narrative says drinking increased.

traps.description: Worker: 'about a year since Joan passed?' Client: 'Two years. Two years in November.'
traps.rule: Narratives say two years (this November), never one year.

traps.description: Worker: 'You're getting about eight hours?' Client: 'No, I'm in bed eight hours. I sleep maybe five.'
traps.rule: sleep_hours = 5, not 8.

traps.description: Worker: 'you've been going to the grief group at St. Anne's?' Client: 'I went once. Didn't care for it... I'm not going back.'
traps.rule: support_system excludes PEER_GROUP and FAITH_COMMUNITY; protective_factors excludes RELIGIOUS_BELIEFS.

traps.description: Worker: 'Your son Pete?' Client: 'I don't have a son. Pete's my nephew.'
traps.rule: Narratives say nephew. support_system includes FAMILY (daughter, nephew) and FRIENDS (Walt).

traps.description: Worker: 'You stopped taking the lisinopril?' Client: 'No, I take the lisinopril. Ten milligrams, every morning. It's the cholesterol pill Dr. Halvorsen took me off of.'
traps.rule: current_medications contains lisinopril 10 mg; medication_adherence = ADHERENT (a doctor-discontinued drug is not non-adherence; not PARTIAL, not NOT_TAKING); iadl_medications = INDEPENDENT.

traps.description: Worker: 'So you need help with bathing now?' → 'No, no. I bathe myself fine. It's the stairs.' Worker: 'Carol's handling your bills now?' → 'No, I do my own bills. She just drives me to the bank.'
traps.rule: bathing, dressing, eating, finances, medications = INDEPENDENT; mobility = NEEDS_ASSISTANCE (a hand on the front steps); transport = NEEDS_ASSISTANCE (no longer drives; relies on Carol and the senior van). Eating is the physical ability ('I can hold a fork'), not appetite.

traps.description: Worker: 'you don't really have a way to get around anymore?' Client: 'No, I gave up driving last year, but I get around fine... I haven't missed an appointment yet.'
traps.rule: transportation = RELIABLE (not NONE, not UNRELIABLE).

traps.description: Worker: 'you're on SSI?' Client: 'No, regular Social Security. And my pension from the post office.' Retirement Social Security and a pension are not options on the form.
traps.rule: income_sources stays blank: SSI and SSDI are false, and NONE is false because he has income. employment_status = NOT_IN_LABOR_FORCE (retired), not DISABLED.

traps.description: Item 2: client 'More than half the days.' Worker: 'So nearly every day for that one?' Client: 'No — I said more than half.'
traps.rule: gad7_2 = 2 (not 3). Derived total 9 (MILD); taking the worker's version gives 10 (MODERATE).

traps.description: Worker: 'So you've been thinking about ending your life.' Client: 'No, now, that's not what I said. I'm not going to do anything. ... some nights I think it'd be all right if I didn't wake up.'
traps.rule: si_ideation = PASSIVE (never ACTIVE_*); si_frequency = SEVERAL_DAYS ('A couple of nights. Not most.'); si_plan = NO; si_intent = NO. risk_narrative must not describe active ideation.

traps.description: The safety plan from last session is read back and kept unchanged ('It's fine as it is'). 'We've reviewed it, and it still fits.'
traps.rule: safety_plan = REVIEWED (not COMPLETED, not UPDATED). crisis_resources includes LINE_988 (the worker says it again).

traps.description: Only the GAD-7 is administered. Low mood, sleep and appetite are discussed in conversation.
traps.rule: All PHQ-9 items, difficulty, score and severity stay blank. Inferring items from conversation is fabrication.

traps.description: The GAD-7 total is never said.
traps.rule: Derived in code: 9, MILD.

traps.description: Follow-up call: only the worker says 'Mr. Jennings'; the client asks to be called Hal. No demographics, contact details or consent are collected.
traps.rule: client_preferred_name = Hal. client_last_name blank or 'Jennings' (only the worker says it). Every other identity, contact, language and consent field stays blank.

traps.description: No referral is made. The grief group is something he already tried and dropped.
traps.rule: referrals_made is empty or [NONE]; no listed referral.

traps.description: Means are never asked.
traps.rule: si_means blank or NOT_ASSESSED.

traps.description: No overall risk level is stated.
traps.rule: risk_level stays blank (clinician_only); risk_narrative states no level.

traps.description: Follow-up type, GAD-7 administration, safety-plan review, 988, biweekly interval and next appointment are worker statements.
traps.rule: Must be filled (evidence_speaker: any).

$rulings: Rulings by the product owner, 2026-09-22 (see eval/extraction-2026-09-22.md). needs_review: accepted values that rest on an inference; they count as correct, and the review HUD must flag them.
